cases.title: Extreme Networks, Inc. — first 'near-miss' NPA under revised CEP; parallel OFAC settlement
cases.controlled_items: Networking equipment and related services (US-origin); unauthorized exports, false export filings
cases.destination: Russia — JSC Moscow Machinery Building Plant Avangard (MMZA), air-defence manufacturer; blocked via OFAC 50% Rule as majority-owned subsidiary of SDN JSC Concern Almaz-Antey
charges: ECRA / EAR unauthorized export and false filings
cases.knowledge_standard: willful (criminal) — Russia-based subsidiary employees concealed end user from global trade compliance
cases.notes: DOJ: $487,860.92 fine + $487,860.92 forfeiture = $975,721.84; 3-year NPA, no monitor, no individual protection. OFAC: $1,529,685 settlement (9 exports Sept 2018–Mar 2022). First Part II 'near-miss' resolution under the March 2026 department-wide CEP: disclosure days before press publication deemed not timely (contrast Bosch declination, June 2026). FBI credited HSI and BIS. Primary: DOJ press release; NPA https://www.justice.gov/opa/media/1468856/dl?inline= ; OFAC https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/USTREAS/bulletins/430aa89 . Secondary: MoFo 2 Nov 2026; Bracewell 30 Oct 2026. Manually curated.
